investigation_notes.Description: The alert was triggered by an unusually large DNS transaction (535 bytes) for domain tiktokcdn.com and high-entropy queries listed in sample_queries. The root domain tiktokcdn.com is long-established (created 2017) and the observed subdomains match common CDN naming conventions rather than Base64-encoded payloads or system file indicators; no decoded sensitive host strings were found. Recent host activity shows prior and repeated queries to tiktokcdn.com and several v*-prefixed subdomains, indicating recurring CDN use from this endpoint. Given the domain age, benign subdomain patterns, and historical host behavior, this is assessed as Low Priority.
